title: Token payloads and headers, contract v1 (DRAFT v1-d2)
description: Pick the $defs entry for the client under test: access_token_cachd, access_token_other (org_claims off), access_token_other_org_claims (org_claims on), id_token, jose_header_*. Claim lists [SRC: PLAN §3.1 L116-123; LD §5 L226, §16.5 L892-894]. Value types [ASSUME A-15 -> OQ-15].

id.description: Opaque id. UUID string assumed [ASSUME A-15 -> OQ-15].

amr.description: Array [SRC: PLAN L118]. Values from RFC 8176; DB sign-in password+TOTP = [pwd, otp, mfa] [ASSUME A-28 -> OQ-22]. Hand-off needs mfa [SRC: LD L1166].

standin_marker.description: Present (true) only on stand-in tokens [SRC: PLAN §3.5]. Rejected outside Development [SRC: PLAN S1 check 11].

no_roles_or_permissions.description: No roles or permissions in any token [SRC: PLAN L121; LD L894]. Names listed are the common ones; tests also assert no other unknown claim via unevaluatedProperties.

aud.description: That client's API only [SRC: PLAN L116]. Single string or one-element array [ASSUME A-15].

client_id.description: OAuth client; never used for tenant scoping [SRC: LD §16.5 L892].

access_token_base.$comment: Lifetime 5 min: tests assert exp - iat == 300 [SRC: PLAN L116].

cachd_client_id.description: Absent for partner-level users [SRC: PLAN L120; LD L892].

location_id.description: The location picked at sign-in [SRC: LD L893].

access_token_cachd.description: Cachd clients (Cash Advance BFF): org claims always, perm_version [SRC: PLAN L119-120].

access_token_other.description: Non-Cachd client (e.g. backoffice_stub) with org_claims off: no perm_version, no org claims [SRC: PLAN L119-120, S1 check 7].

access_token_other_org_claims.description: Non-Cachd client with org_claims on: org claims, still no perm_version [SRC: LD §16.5 L893].

id_token.description: [SRC: PLAN L122-123]. Lifetime not stated [ASSUME A-15: 5 min -> OQ-15].

kid.description: Stand-in kids start with standin- [SRC: PLAN §3.5].
